items.text: Document title differs: A uses a generic 'Home' title, while B uses the full organization name.
items.evidence: A_facts title 'Home'; B_facts title 'F N Souza International Fine Arts Foundation'

items.text: A includes a 'generator' meta tag, while B includes 'charset' and 'viewport' meta names instead.
items.evidence: A meta_names [content-type, description, generator]; B meta_names [charset, viewport, description]

items.text: The h1 text differs: A's first h1 is a painting title ('CIUDAD EN ESAPANA'), while B's h1 is 'Modern & Contemporary Art'.
items.evidence: A h1.text 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA'; B h1.text 'Modern & Contemporary Art'

items.text: The heading font family differs: A's h1 uses Cabin sans-serif in bold, while B's h1 uses a Georgia serif at regular weight.
items.evidence: A h1 font 'Cabin, sans-serif' weight 700; B h1 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif' weight 400

items.text: B's headings are larger: the h1 is 84px vs 60px and the h2 is 46px vs 20px.
items.evidence: A h1 60px, h2 20px; B h1 84px, h2 46px

items.text: A's site name is set as a wide, all-caps display wordmark with a script tagline ('History & Works'). B shows the name as a small two-line serif text logo at the top left.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 large centered 'F N SOUZA INTERNATIONAL FINE ARTS…' with script 'History & Works'; B_slice_00 small serif name at top left

items.text: The body text metrics differ slightly.
items.evidence: A body 16px/30px; B body 17px/28.05px

items.text: The accent color differs: A uses a red (rgb 232,43,24), for example on the active 'HOME' nav item and the user icon. B uses an orange (rgb 232,102,58) on the announcement bar, buttons and links.
items.evidence: A top_backgrounds rgb(232,43,24) x7; B top_backgrounds rgb(232,102,58) x3; screenshots

items.text: B uses a muted secondary text tone (rgb 163,154,142) for supporting copy.
items.evidence: B top_text_colors rgb(163,154,142) x18

items.text: A's hero is an image carousel of paintings, with circular pagination dots and a slide title overlaid in white. B's hero is a static dark, abstract textured background with left-aligned text.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA' over a painting with 9 dot indicators; B_slice_00 dark brushy background, no dots

items.text: A's nine slide titles are not presented as hero slides in B. Instead, B lists them in an italic serif horizontal strip separated by orange diamond bullets.
items.evidence: B_slice_00 strip: 'Ciudad En Esapana • Multicoloured Villagescape • Vatican Cityscape…' in italics

items.text: A's header is a semi-transparent band laid over the hero image, with the wordmark and nav centered. B's header is a horizontal bar with the logo on the left and the nav on the right.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 translucent band with centered content (rgba(1,1,0,0.53) bg); B_slice_00 left logo, right-aligned nav

items.text: A's nav items are uppercase. B's nav items are title case, and 'Family History' and 'Available For Sale' have small dropdown carets.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 'ABOUT F N SOUZA', 'FAMILY HISTORY'…; B_slice_00 'Family History ▾', 'Available For Sale ▾'

items.text: The forgery-exoneration notice appears as a long uppercase nav item wrapping over two lines in A. In B it is an underlined link in a full-width orange announcement bar at the very top.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 nav line 'F. N. SOUZA EXONERATES SON… WITH FORGERIES'; B_slice_00 orange top bar with the same text in title case

items.text: Corner rounding: A has some rounded or pill elements (circles, dots), while B has zero rounded corners anywhere.
items.evidence: A radius buckets pill 11, 16+ 2; B pill 0, 16+ 0, bucket_0 97

items.text: The artist bio layout differs. A shows a small 176×131 portrait thumbnail next to centered serif paragraph text with an inline 'Read More' link. B uses a two-column layout with a large 473×275 photo on the left and a heading, left-aligned paragraph and separate orange 'Read More' link on the right.
items.evidence: A fnsouza.jpg rect 176×131; B rect 473×275; A_slice_01 vs B_slice_00

items.text: The gallery grids differ. A shows the six artworks in two rows of three at natural size (442px tall) within a 135–1305px container. B shows five thumbnails in one 243px-tall row, then a sixth image (Mother and child) blown up to 740×1214.
items.evidence: A image rects all h 442; B five images h 243 at y 1541, mother_child rect 740×1214 from natural 270×442

items.text: In B, the bio photo's 473px rendered width exceeds its 370px natural width at a natural 275px height, so the image is stretched or cropped horizontally.
items.evidence: B fnsouza.jpg natural 370×275, rect 473×275

items.text: Section wrappers: A has 1 <section> and 3 <header> elements, while B has 3 <section> elements and 1 <header>.
items.evidence: A section 1, header 3; B section 3, header 1

items.text: The contact form layout differs. A uses two columns, with Name, Email and Phone on the left and Message on the right, light grey placeholder fields, and a centered outlined button. B uses a single narrow column with uppercase labels above dark bordered fields and a left-aligned orange button.
items.evidence: A_slice_02 two-column form with rgb(246,246,246) fields; B_slice_02 stacked NAME/EMAIL/MESSAGE labels

items.text: The footer content differs. A has a centered '© 2021 | PRIVACY POLICY' on black plus a 'More Art Gallery Templates at TemplateMonster.com' credit. B has the full foundation name in the copyright on the left and 'Privacy Policy' on the right, above a thin divider.
items.evidence: A_slice_03; B_slice_02/03

items.text: Neither page uses box shadows, gradients or backdrop blur.
items.evidence: box_shadows 0, gradient_backgrounds 0, backdrop_blur 0 on both

items.text: Layout mechanisms: B uses CSS grid (5) and flexbox (6), while A uses no grid and a single flex container.
items.evidence: A display_grid 0, display_flex 1; B display_grid 5, display_flex 6

items.text: B's content is aligned to a left edge at x=160, whereas A centers most section headings and text.
items.evidence: B image rects x 160, headings left-aligned in screenshots; A centered shapes and paragraph in A_slice_00–02

items.text: B's hero has two calls to action: a filled 'VIEW THE GALLERY' button and an outlined 'ABOUT THE ARTIST' button. A's hero has no buttons.
items.evidence: B_slice_00 two buttons below the subtitle; A_slice_00 hero shows only a title and pagination dots

items.text: B's sections are separated by subtle shifts in background tone (rgb 15,14,13 vs rgb 25,23,22) and thin divider lines. A separates sections with white space on a uniform white background.
items.evidence: B top_backgrounds rgb(25,23,22) x6, rgb(15,14,13) x2; B_slice_02 tone change before Contact

features.statement: Page title uses the full organization name rather than a generic label like 'Home'.
Head includes charset and viewport meta tags alongside description, for responsive, modern markup.
Headings use a Georgia-style serif at regular weight instead of bold sans-serif.
Headings are very large, with an h1 around 84px and h2 around 46px, giving strong hierarchy.
Body text is about 17px with a tighter line height near 1.65.
Typography is limited to a system sans stack plus one serif, with no custom web fonts.
Site name appears as a small two-line serif text logo at top left.
A single warm orange accent color is used for the announcement bar, buttons, links and bullets.
Supporting copy uses a muted warm grey tone on a dark background.
Page uses a dark theme, with sections separated by subtle background tone shifts and thin divider lines.
Hero is a static dark textured background with left-aligned text, without a carousel or pagination dots.
Hero presents a filled primary button next to an outlined secondary button.
Item titles are listed in an italic serif strip separated by diamond bullets.
Header is a horizontal bar with logo on the left and navigation on the right.
Navigation labels use title case, and dropdown items carry small caret indicators.
A full-width colored announcement bar at the very top holds an underlined notice link.
All corners are square, with no rounded elements, pills or circles.
Design is flat, with no box shadows, gradients or backdrop blur.
Content is left-aligned to a consistent left edge, including headings and intro paragraphs.
Bio section uses two columns, with a large photo on the left and heading, paragraph and link on the right.
Images are distorted or oversized, with stretched photos and one enlarged image breaking an otherwise uniform thumbnail row.
Page uses multiple section elements and a single header, with a clean h1 followed by h2 section headings.
Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox.
Contact form is a single narrow column with uppercase labels above dark bordered fields and a left-aligned accent button.
Footer places the full name in the copyright on the left and a Privacy Policy link on the right, above a thin divider.
Hero headline is a short descriptive category phrase rather than an artwork title.
